outcome: ongoing suspicion of retained products of conception
cohort: The study included 88 patients diagnosed with retained products of conception after 23+0 weeks of gestation at the Medical University Vienna between 2014 and 2022.
finding: Primary surgical management was associated with significantly higher complication rates (68.1% vs 24.4%) and a greater likelihood of requiring a secondary change in treatment compared to primary conservative management for retained products of conception.
gest_age: greater than or equal to 23+0 weeks
